node_8.subject: Arthur Burton
node_8.description: This is Arthur Burton's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, wake up and complete the morning routine from 7:00 am to 7:30 am, attend chemistry class in classroom 1 from 8:00 am to 9:30 am, have a quick break and chat with friends from 9:30 am to 10:00 am, attend history class in classroom 1 from 10:00 am to 11:30 am, eat lunch at the cafeteria from 11:30 am to 12:30 pm, study for the chemistry competition in the library from 12:30 pm to 2:00 pm, attend physical education class in the sports room from 2:00 pm to 3:30 pm, work on election campaign materials in the student dormitory from 3:30 pm to 4:00 pm, eat dinner at the dormitory at 4:00 pm, attend a student council meeting from 4:30 pm to 5:30 pm, practice for the chemistry competition in the library from 6:00 pm to 8:00 pm, have a light snack and socialize with dorm mates from 8:00 pm to 8:30 pm, finish homework and prepare for the next day's classes from 8:30 pm to 10:00 pm, relax and chat with friends online from 10:00 pm to 11:30 pm, wind down and get ready for bed from 11:30 pm to midnight.
